channel.title: Ravi Bhushan Ojha — Essays
channel.description: Essays on product engineering, AI adoption, systems thinking, and engineering leadership by Ravi Bhushan Ojha, VP of Product Engineering at Zithara Technology.

item.title: Who Trains the Next Senior Engineers?
item.dc:creator: Ravi Bhushan Ojha
item.description: AI now does the work juniors used to learn on. So where will the next senior engineers come from?

item.title: Meta Changed How WhatsApp Business Charges You. Here's the Strategy.
item.dc:creator: Ravi Bhushan Ojha
item.description: Per-message pricing is live. The 24-hour window becomes billable in October 2026. Here's what to fix before the bill arrives — especially your AI reply flows.

item.title: Digitalization Didn't Just Automate the Real World. It Changed How We Think About It.
item.dc:creator: Ravi Bhushan Ojha
item.description: When the real world moved into systems, clarity entered decision-making. And with clarity, questions started surfacing — the right ones.

item.title: Work Gets Done Right When Humans Ask the Right Questions
item.dc:creator: Ravi Bhushan Ojha
item.description: Why clarity of thinking matters more than speed — especially in the age of AI.

item.title: Why Common Sense Is the Most Underrated Skill in Product Engineering
item.dc:creator: Ravi Bhushan Ojha
item.description: How simplicity and judgment outperform complexity at scale.

item.title: Building Technology for Retail Taught Me This: Effort Doesn't Scale, Systems Do
item.dc:creator: Ravi Bhushan Ojha
item.description: When systems don't talk, people compensate. And people don't scale.
